title: Water Act 2007
converter: cth_convert_sym_v15mu.py (a copy of docx_text() and the volume joining of the workbench converter harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py that also maps Symbol-font and private-use characters; kept outside the repository); the first deposit used harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py

symbol_repair_2026_11_08.previous_converter: harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py (docx_text), the converter of the 2026-10-13 deposit
symbol_repair_2026_11_08.from: the same Word files of C2026C00398 (C2026C00398VOL01.docx and C2026C00398VOL02.docx; joined in order, sha256 cde5f1a751f7b6140b6460b52a0c82aa40f93d335c745b220104f80f7448c9e5, this deposit's download_sha256)
symbol_repair_2026_11_08.why: docx_text() dropped characters Word writes as Symbol-font w:sym elements. cth_convert_sym_v15mu.py maps them to Unicode (Symbol F06D μ, F0B4 × and the like), Wingdings boxes to "[ ]", and private-use code points U+F0xx the same way; run with its mapping switched off it reproduces the first deposit byte for byte.
symbol_repair_2026_11_08.what_changed: One Greek small mu (Symbol F06D -> μ, the micro prefix) restored at line 7907, the note to clause 7(1) of Schedule B (Basin Salinity Management) to the Murray-Darling Basin Agreement in Schedule 1: "Note: E.C. stands for Electrical Conductivity, measured in S/cm." is now "Note: E.C. stands for Electrical Conductivity, measured in μS/cm." Without the μ the unit read as siemens per centimetre, a factor of 10^6 out, so the 800 E.C. Basin Salinity Target was stated in the wrong unit. A diff against the first deposit shows no other change; same 11,398 lines, one character more. Line numbers are unchanged, so the formulas sidecar's line references still hold. Incomplete: nine Symbol bullets that Word draws from automatic numbering were also lost; restored on 2026-11-08, see bullet_repair_2026_11_08.
symbol_repair_2026_11_08.encodings_affected: none: the subject has no encodings, and no encoding elsewhere cites this deposit

bullet_repair_2026_11_08.how: by hand from the same Word files (C2026C00398VOL02.docx): each of the nine paragraphs now starts with a bullet and a tab, as cth_convert_sym_v5n.py (kept outside the repository) writes numbering bullets; that converter's output for these Word files differs from the repaired text only at line 7907, the micro sign it does not map
bullet_repair_2026_11_08.why: An independent check found nine notepara paragraphs with numId 17, level 0, whose bullet numbering.xml defines as Symbol F0B7. The text has no w:sym element there, so the 2026-11-08 reconversion (cth_convert_sym_v15mu.py, which does not read numbering) left them without a bullet.
bullet_repair_2026_11_08.what_changed: Lines 9480-9482 (Note 1) and 9484-9489 (Note 2) to clause 2(2) of Schedule H (Water Sharing during tiers 2 and 3) to the Murray-Darling Basin Agreement now start with a bullet; same 11,398 lines, 18 characters more; nothing else changed.
bullet_repair_2026_11_08.encodings_affected: none: the subject has no encodings
